<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_587457_pear.PEAR_Utils2</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PEAR_Utils2</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var PEAR_Utils2 = Class.create();
PEAR_Utils2.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

	getConcernedApplicativeAccessOfBusinessPart: function (bp_sysId) {
		var query = "";
		var AllLabelComponents = ['technical_role','business_unit','organization','project','group','company'];
		if (!bp_sysId) {
			bp_sysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_bp_sysId');
		}

		// gs.info('getConcernedApplicativeAccessOfBusinessPart ' + bp_sysId);

		var bp_LabelCompontents = [];
		var bp = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_business_part_of_app_access');
		if(bp.get(bp_sysId))
		{
			for (i=0; i<AllLabelComponents.length;i++)
			{
				if(!gs.nil(bp.getValue(AllLabelComponents[i])))
					//bp_LabelCompontents.push(bp.getValue(AllLabelComponents[i]))
					bp_LabelCompontents.push(AllLabelComponents[i])
			}
			// gs.info('getConcernedApplicativeAccessOfBusinessPart bp_LabelCompontents ' + bp_LabelCompontents.toString());

			var aa = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_applicative_access');
			for(j=0;j<bp_LabelCompontents.length;j++)
			{
				// gs.info('getConcernedApplicativeAccessOfBusinessPart bp_LabelCompontents[j] ' + bp_LabelCompontents[j] + ' > ' + bp.getValue(bp_LabelCompontents[j]))

				aa.addQuery(bp_LabelCompontents[j],bp.getValue(bp_LabelCompontents[j]))
			}
			aa.query();
			gs.info('getConcernedApplicativeAccessOfBusinessPart aa query ' + aa.getEncodedQuery())
			query = aa.getEncodedQuery();

		}
		return query;
	}, 

	getApplicativeAccessFormatbyApp: function (Application){

		var result = "";
		if (!Application) {
			Application = this.getParameter('sysparm_Application');
		}
		gs.info('getApplicativeAccessFormatbyApp Application ' + Application)
		var app = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_application');
		if(app.get(Application))
			result = app.applicative_access_format.format + "|" + app.applicative_access_format.separator;

		return result;

	},


	isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile: function (BusinessProfileId) {
		gs.info('isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile START')

		if (!BusinessProfileId) {
			BusinessProfileId = this.getParameter('sysparm_BusinessProfileId');
		}



		var BusinessProfileRequiredProjects = [];
		// 1) Business Parts attivi per BP
		var BusinessPart = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_business_part_of_app_access');
		BusinessPart.addQuery('business_profile_id', BusinessProfileId);
		// BusinessPart.addQuery('status', 'active');
		BusinessPart.query();
		gs.info('isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile BusinessPart count ' + BusinessPart.getRowCount())
		gs.info('isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile BusinessPart query ' + BusinessPart.getEncodedQuery())
		while(BusinessPart.next())
		{
			// gs.info(BusinessPart.label);
			var ApplicativeAccess = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_applicative_access');
			ApplicativeAccess.addQuery("business_part_id",BusinessPart.sys_id);
			ApplicativeAccess.query();
			gs.info('isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile ApplicativeAccess query ' + ApplicativeAccess.getEncodedQuery())
			gs.info('isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile ApplicativeAccess count ' + ApplicativeAccess.getRowCount())

			while(ApplicativeAccess.next())
			{
				gs.info('isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile searching for ApplicativeAccess.app_id ' + ApplicativeAccess.app_id)
				// gs.info(ApplicativeAccess.app_id.getDisplayValue())
				var ApplicativeAccessFormat = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_app_access_format');
				ApplicativeAccessFormat.get('app_id',ApplicativeAccess.app_id);
				gs.info('isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile format ' + ApplicativeAccessFormat.format)
				// gs.info("\n\nBusinessPart " + BusinessPart.label + 'ApplicativeAccess ' + ApplicativeAccess.label + 'Format ' + ApplicativeAccessFormat.format)
				// if(ApplicativeAccessFormat.format.toString().contains('prj'))
				if(ApplicativeAccessFormat.format.toString().contains('project'))
				{
					if(!BusinessProfileRequiredProjects.toString().contains(ApplicativeAccess.project_space_id.toString()))
						BusinessProfileRequiredProjects.push(ApplicativeAccess.project_space_id.toString())
				}
			}
		}

		gs.info('isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile BusinessProfileRequiredProjects.length ' + BusinessProfileRequiredProjects.length)

		if(BusinessProfileRequiredProjects.length==0)
			return false;
		else
			return true;

    },

    type: 'PEAR_Utils2'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-11-04 14:00:29</sys_created_on><sys_id>14b294094709b210c361f19f016d4399</sys_id><sys_mod_count>28</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PEAR_Utils2</sys_name><sys_package display_value="PEAR" source="x_587457_pear">145cb95a47fcb210c361f19f016d439b</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="PEAR">145cb95a47fcb210c361f19f016d439b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_14b294094709b210c361f19f016d4399</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-11-13 23:58:19</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
